title: RATEB ERP Enterprise Offline Persistence — Architecture Audit
goal: Offline ERP must behave like an installed desktop app. Hard Refresh / restart / internet-off must not destroy Offline ERP. Only Logout, Device Revoke, or user Clear Site Data may remove it.

score_notes.hard_refresh_survival: Ctrl+Shift+R offline bypasses Service Worker (platform). Online hard refresh works via network. Soft F5 offline can survive if caches warm.
score_notes.sw_update_safety: install skipWaiting + seedInlineOfflineShell deletes offline-shell.html before offline fetch can restore; nuclear live-escape wipes all rateb-* caches.
score_notes.session_persistence: IDB auth_vault + localStorage survive restart; sessionStorage unlock TTL does not (PIN required after restart — acceptable policy).
score_notes.cache_persistence: Ops page version bumps orphan snapshots; nuclear purge destroys survival; coexist migrate exists but ops migrate does not.

primary_blockers: Hard Refresh offline cannot be served by SW (browser platform) — contract unmet without installable PWA / documented soft-reload UX
seedInlineOfflineShell deletes real offline-shell.html then aborts if offline — SW update can destroy shell
Nuclear purge paths (live-escape / purgeStaleOfflineAndReload) unregister SW + delete all rateb-* caches
RatebOffline.ensure() injects scripts from network/Cache — cold offline boot fails if protected warm incomplete
Ops-pages cache rename orphans Admin HTML until re-warm online

survival_matrix.soft_F5_offline_warm: Survives via SW cache / ops pages / shell
survival_matrix.hard_refresh_CtrlShiftR_offline: FAILS — browser bypasses SW → Chrome interstitial
survival_matrix.browser_restart_offline_enrolled: Identity survives; PIN required; modules need Cache hit
survival_matrix.sw_update_while_offline: AT RISK — seedInlineOfflineShell may delete shell without restore
survival_matrix.rateb_live_second_hop: DESTROYS — unregister all SW + delete all rateb-* caches

issues.title: Hard Refresh offline bypasses Service Worker
issues.file: Browser platform (Chrome); no handler in pos-sw.js
issues.root_cause: Ctrl+Shift+R forces network-only document load and skips the controlling Service Worker. Cached shell cannot answer that navigation.
issues.impact: Internet OFF + Hard Refresh → Chrome 'no connection' interstitial. Breaks desktop-app contract.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Treat Hard Refresh offline as unsupported OR ship installable PWA window that never hard-refreshes; UX: soft reload button that goes through SW; document that only Soft Reload is the offline contract.

issues.title: seedInlineOfflineShell deletes offline-shell.html then aborts when offline
issues.root_cause: On install, coexist cache deletes shellUrl/ERP_OFFLINE_SHELL before fetch. If isCloudBrowserOffline(), returns null without restoring OA shell.
issues.impact: SW update while offline can wipe the only real offline shell; user falls to thin inline shell or failure.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Never delete shell until acceptable body is fetched and put. If offline, skip delete entirely. Versioned put alongside old shell (migrate, don't destroy).

issues.title: Nuclear live-escape destroys all Offline ERP caches + unregisters SW
issues.root_cause: On rateb_live / rateb_force_live recovery when probe succeeds, code unregisters ALL service workers and caches.delete every key matching /^rateb-/i.
issues.impact: One recovery hop wipes shell, ops pages, allowlist, coexist. Offline ERP requires full online re-warm. Violates 'only logout/revoke/user clear' rule.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Soft escape only: navigate with bypass query; never unregister; never bulk-delete caches. Nuclear purge only behind explicit debug flag.

issues.title: RatebOffline.ensure() depends on Cache/network script inject
issues.root_cause: Modular OA loads scripts via <script src>. No IndexedDB blob fallback. Offline boot requires PROTECTED assets already in Cache API.
issues.impact: Hard refresh / cold tab offline with incomplete warm → SDK never boots → no unlock/queue/nav.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Gate 'Offline Ready' on protected warm complete; fallback to monolith rateb-offline.js already in PROTECTED list; never require network for ensure() after activation.

issues.title: Dual device-UUID generators
issues.root_cause: Two writers for rateb_erp_device_uuid with different prefixes; first writer wins.
issues.impact: Device enroll vs unlock mismatch → device_unknown after restart despite prior activation.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Single canonical getDeviceId; migrate/alias existing keys; server bind one UUID.

issues.title: Ops-pages cache version bump orphans Admin HTML
issues.root_cause: Coexist caches are migrated; ops-pages-* are neither migrated nor deleted on activate. New version name → empty ops cache until warm.
issues.impact: After deploy, offline module nav fails until online re-warm.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Migrate rateb-erp-ops-pages-* like coexist; or keep stable cache name and content-hash entries.

issues.title: Immediate skipWaiting + clients.claim on every update
issues.root_cause: New SW activates and claims before background warm finishes; install may have deleted shell.
issues.impact: Race: brief window where protected assets / shell missing after update.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Claim OK for nav; never delete critical assets on install; warm must be idempotent and complete before advertising Offline Ready.

issues.title: Online enroll can defer PIN seal; unlock skipped while online
issues.root_cause: PIN seal deferred; online path marks unlocked without sealing vault.
issues.impact: Device not Offline-Ready until first offline PIN; pending LS loss → cold start fail.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Require PIN seal before Offline Ready=true; surface readiness in UI.

issues.title: Allowlist seed too small on cache miss
issues.root_cause: If allowlist JSON not cached, tiny seed allowlist used.
issues.impact: Many modules fall through to uncached/shell offline after SW restart.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Embed full production allowlist in SW build artifact.

issues.title: Parent-list / any-admin fallback can serve wrong HTML
issues.root_cause: Cache miss substitutes parent list or any admin page.
issues.impact: Offline nav opens wrong page content under target URL.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Prefer explicit uncached banner over wrong HTML; never silent rewrite.

issues.title: Unlock TTL only in sessionStorage
issues.root_cause: By design unlock window is session-scoped.
issues.impact: Browser restart always requires PIN (acceptable); idle 15m also re-PIN.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Document as policy; optional longer kiosk idle via config.

issues.title: Unversioned IndexedDB open race
issues.line: shell-auth ~340 without version; storage opens DB_VERSION 2
issues.root_cause: Mixed open signatures on first cold start.
issues.impact: Possible upgrade race on first open.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Always open via RatebOfflineSchema.openDatabase() with DB_VERSION.

issues.title: Pending identity plaintext in localStorage
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Opaque server blob or encrypt-at-rest; TTL purge.

issues.title: Legacy rateb-offline-sw aggressive cache deletes
issues.impact: If dual-registered, can wipe ERP caches.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Keep unregister-on-upgrade; remove legacy SW from production deploy.

issues.title: Soft-online SWR serves cache over network on normal F5
issues.impact: Users see stale Admin after soft reload while online; confuse with hard-refresh expectations.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Keep for offline UX; expose clear 'force live' without nuclear purge.

issues.title: Build bump clears warm markers only
issues.root_cause: Clears full-warm session markers; identity untouched.
issues.impact: Re-warm pressure after deploy; not identity wipe.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Re-warm automatically without user action; keep identity.

issues.title: Monolith vs modular OA drift
issues.impact: Fixes may land in one path only.
issues.enterprise_recommendation: Single source of truth; generate monolith from modules.

what_survives_today: IndexedDB auth_vault across hard refresh and browser restart
Soft F5 offline when ops/coexist caches warm
what_does_not_meet_contract: Cold offline boot without protected warm
Post-deploy ops-pages version orphan until re-warm
enterprise_target_architecture_recommend: Define Offline Ready = enrolled + PIN sealed + protected assets warm + allowlist warm + min ops pages warm
Versioned cache migration for ALL critical caches (shell, coexist, ops, allowlist) — never delete before copy
Remove nuclear purge from production live-escape
ensure() local-only after activation (Cache or embedded blobs)
Document Soft Reload as offline reload; Hard Refresh offline unsupported or PWA-window only
SW update must be additive; old shell retained until new shell verified
